label: 4th original input (t=3), gated by token identity
explanation: Positional unit: fires only during the original-input phase, almost entirely at step t=3 (92% of activation mass; t=2 7%, t=4 2%), never at t=0-1, t>=5, the delimiter, or the copy phase. Only ~11% of t=3 steps are active, and which ones depends additively on token identity: the current input being v, u, 3, j, t, b (v strongest; top activations are nearly all v/u at t=3) and earlier inputs including n, 2, p, t, j, 1, q, o, k. Restricting to in_tok in {v,u,3,j,t,b} with at least one of those earlier tokens raises dev precision to 0.42 but cuts mass recall to 0.55; no clean boolean rule captures the graded token weighting. Fires mostly on the first occurrence of the input token (in_first=1 holds 92% of mass). Slightly more frequent for short L (4-6).
